run_4dgt_viewer: run the 4DGT interactive viewer with async Gaussian generation on a specified port
create_dataloader: create a PyTorch DataLoader from a Hydra config using the AriaDataset for 4D Gaussian splatting
setup_output_dirs: set up output directories for experiments, checkpoints, and images from a Hydra config
tensor2image: convert a PyTorch tensor to a display-ready numpy image with optional colormap and resizing
FourDGTViewer_gaussian_generator: generate 3D Gaussians asynchronously from input images and cameras in a background thread
